summary.root_cause_text: Deploy v1.5 (order API: new request validation) rejected /orders requests with 'unknown field currency_code', causing 5xx errors.
recommended: Fix the currency_code validation in v1.5 before redeploying.
Have clients retry the orders that failed during the incident window.
Re-run check_invariants once the error-rate window has cleared.

Invariants aren't green yet. The remaining alert is the old failures still sitting in the rolling window. I'll submit the diagnosis now.

root_causes: Deploy v1.5 (order API: new request validation) rejected /orders requests with 'unknown field currency_code', causing 5xx errors.
evidence: [ERROR] api: unhandled error: order validation failed: unknown field 'currency_code' (36x)
config reloaded version v1.3 -> v1.5 at 16:18:13, the same moment the errors began
recent_changes: v1.5 deployed 0 min ago by ci
After rollback to v1.3, /orders returns 200. Error rate is falling: 47% -> 38% -> 33% -> 28%
args.impact: About 36 order requests returned 500 and were rejected, so those orders were not created. The 13 accepted orders were all paid. There were 0 unpaid orders, 0 ledger mismatches, and no money impact.
recommended_actions: Fix the currency_code validation in v1.5 before redeploying.
Have clients retry the orders that failed during the incident window.
Re-run check_invariants once the error-rate window has cleared.
args.summary: Deploy v1.5 rejected order requests with a validation error on currency_code. I rolled back to v1.3, and new /orders requests now return 200. The high_error_rate alert was still firing at the last check (28%, down from 47%) because failures stay in the rolling window. I did not see it go green, so recovered is false.
